docs.title: AP Precalculus
docs.text: This course establishes foundational mastery of function behavior, algebraic transformations, rates of change, and mathematical modeling across four comprehensive units.

docs.title: Unit 1: Polynomial & Rational Functions
docs.text: Unit 1 explores how quantities change in tandem, the rate of change of functions over intervals, and the asymptotic behavior of algebraic expressions.

docs.title: Unit 2: Exponential & Logarithmic Functions
docs.text: Unit 2 explores processes characterized by proportional and multiplicative change, building from discrete sequences to continuous exponential growth and their algebraic inverses: logarithmic functions.

docs.title: Unit 3: Trigonometric & Polar Functions
docs.text: Unit 3 examines periodic motion and angular displacement, transitioning from geometric right-triangle definitions to the circular function definitions on the coordinate plane, sinusoidal modeling, inverse trigonometric functions, and polar coordinates.

docs.title: Unit 4: Functions Involving Parameters, Vectors, & Matrices
docs.text: Unit 4 extends analytical geometry and functional relationships into multidimensional contexts, including parametric equations of motion, implicit algebraic curves (conic sections), vector operations, and linear transformations via matrices.
